item.title: Dear Abby: I’m expecting, and relatives won’t vax
item.description: Some of my family members are resistant to getting these vaccines and want us to consider other options, like testing and wearing a mask, which is not as safe. Also, it would be hard for younger kids to do -- my niece is 3.
